question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66716bf90a3a1599047d34642a9118e66f519d377ed85dc84774d8b21a194d63.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The letters on the Top and Bottom are shifted to their places in the next box. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f5176a40b499fc288a82a4d2485d854e63604b5fedc7902d4e41ab587cfba91.png] 

Step II: The letters in the top/bottom along with the middle are shifted to their positions in triangle form in alternate boxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/745a5d069c97511260e0684e39cd46a3812d926cfb9506f5b576adf87bc9d02f.png] 

Thus, the next image will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/310d1663652732d094c7e7479fe25ed26b30b9b8e6906a0dc4325d5992d7cd39.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 3**__'.
